messages:
Maya: Hey team — EmberCorp wants a final runtime readiness call next week for their Private deployment. Can we lock a slot and draft the agenda? Looking for 45m. Proposed times: Mon 3/29 10am PT, Tue 3/30 9am PT, Wed 3/31 2pm PT. Reply with preferred or add new slot.
Liam: I can do Mon or Wed. Tue conflicts with a release cut.
Andre: Tue is rough for me, Mon 10am PT works.
Raj: Wed 2pm PT better for infra folks. If Mon, we need an extra 15m for network test.
Maya: Noted — who should represent runtime/kv cache and who will own the quantization/checklist?
Emma: I'll own KV cache warmup and prefix caching checklist.
Andre: I'll cover quantization profile + kernel selection notes. Will prep a 5-slide doc.
Liam: I'll run the canary rollout plan and the fallback policy section. Also want to run the runbook handoff.
Maya: Agenda draft:
- Intros (5m)
- Deployment surface + customer constraints (5m)
- KV cache and warmup plan (10m) @Emma
- Quantization and perf expectations (10m) @Andre
- Canary rollout + fallback policy (8m) @Liam
- Network and VPN post-flight tests (5m) @Raj
- Action items and owners (2m)
Please flag missing items.
Raj: Add "SLOs and monitoring thresholds" under network tests.
Emma: Also add "customer secrets & KMS handshake" — who's touching keys in their VPC?
Andre: @Maya can we get EmberCorp's infra lead on the call to confirm firewall/NAT rules? We had issues last time.
Maya: Yes, pinged them in email; waiting on a reply. I'll add a calendar invite once time is decided and include runbook link.
Liam: Time poll tally: Mon 10am PT (Maya, Andre), Tue 9am PT (none), Wed 2pm PT (Raj, Emma, Liam). Looks like Wed wins but Mon has runtime availability.
Maya: OK, let's pick Wed 2pm PT to maximize infra presence. 45m slot. I'll send invite and attach docs.
ops-bot: Reminder — set Zoom link and enable customer breakout. Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Maya: Emma/Andre/Liam, please drop slide links and any pre-reads by EOD Tues.
Emma: KV cache checklist draft: https://drive.redwood/example-kv-warmup.md
Andre: Quant profiles + perf matrix: https://drive.redwood/quant-profiles.xlsx
Liam: Canary runbook snippet:
```
- 10% traffic for 15m
- monitor lat>p95, token loss
- fallback to v1 on errors>=5% for 5m
```
Maya: Awesome. Also can someone confirm we have a dedicated NAT IP for EmberCorp's VPC? Raj?
Raj: Yes, confirmed. I'll attach the network test script and runbook: https://internal.redwood/net-tests.sh
Maya: Thanks. If EmberCorp confirms, we'll proceed. I'll post final invite and agenda update shortly. :rocket:
Andre: FYI, planning to run a quick perf smoke on the private cluster Wed morning and report results.
Emma: I'll do a KV cache dry-run Tue evening and post timings.
Maya: Great. Closing — Wed 2pm PT locked unless someone raises a hard blocker before EOD. Thanks!
